reason: Carry the former plugin identities of Tagma apps into their app names in three history tables: notification.sender plugin:<id> becomes app:<id>, so an app's earlier questions still deliver their outcomes and its send keys still repeat; thread_call.actor and spent_call_key.actor external.plugin:<id> of input calls become external.app:<id>, so a retried turn of the app replays instead of admitting it twice. Each is one UPDATE that scans its table once; no index or table is rebuilt and no row is added. The installation estimates the work from notification, thread_call and spent_call_key max(rowid) and the snapshot bytes before replacing the running server.
